rationale: The plan addresses the core requirement: compare volume, paid amounts, denial rate and fraud-flag rate across both provider specialties and network status, plus rank the top 10 rendering providers. The provider_join step validates data quality and ensures the provider directory is the authoritative source for specialty and network status. The group_comparison step uses the combined specialty+network_status grouping to directly answer how money and denials distribute across both dimensions. The provider_ranking step identifies the most active providers by claim volume with their certified attributes. All required artifacts are produced by this sequence.
